annotation.title_clean: Guidelines on the ethical use of artificial intelligence and data in teaching and learning
annotation.title_en: Guidelines on the ethical use of artificial intelligence and data in teaching and learning
annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Commission, Directorate-General for Education, Youth, Sport and Culture
annotation.summary_en: European Commission web page presenting updated guidelines on ethical use of AI and data in teaching and learning for primary and secondary educators. It describes the guidelines' contents (scenarios, AI Act and GDPR context, glossary), the 2022 and 2026 versions, and Erasmus+ funding calls. It does not reproduce the guidelines' text.
key_provisions_or_claims: Updated guidelines help teachers make ethical, context-based decisions on AI and data use
Explains AI Act and GDPR compliance context for schools
Includes guiding questions, scenarios and an updated glossary
Update prepared by Working Group via European Digital Education Hub in 2026
Erasmus+ 2026 calls fund ethical AI in education projects
